'''Lesi Garahe''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Pureblood]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]] she resided on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]], where under behest of [[Darth Serevin]] she asked an Imperial to deal with a [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] chief [[Raklann]].
